architecture_override.authority: ADR-0012 governs Logical Tunnel multipath/lifecycle; ADR-0011 governs each lane's same-association bootstrap/no-HOL. Withdrawn ADR-0014 must not globalize single-flow or restore break-before-make.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE / TRANSPORT EPOCH. One Logical Tunnel owns stable TunnelID/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain with 1..4 logical lanes. Each lane is a complete transport association; Game is first-arrival + dedup with no cross-lane HOL; FEC never crosses lanes.
architecture_override.replacement: Healthy replacement is A -> A+B -> B; candidate failure preserves A. At most 4 logical lanes exist. A fifth physical slot is replacement overlap only, never as a fifth logical lane. Server may recover a lost client LEAVE from a later authenticated same-session same-LaneID incarnation without adding a new wire ACK/version.
architecture_override.windows_outer_path: Sustained Windows outer path is real Npcap/raw FakeTCP. Reality-like real TLS 1.3 bootstrap and pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 remain on the SAME raw FakeTCP association; there is no ordinary kernel-TCP Reality preconnection.
architecture_override.server_path: Linux final path is one shared WBD TUN + root routing + one WBD-owned host NAT.
architecture_override.lease_source_boundary: Raw IPv4 ingress requires source == server-issued Logical Tunnel lease. Wintun must not leak APIPA/arbitrary IPv4 or non-IPv4 into the IPv4 Game/raw-IP backend.
architecture_override.ipv6: Windows product IPv6 remains fail-closed until qualified.

mtu_contract.user_visible_semantics: Both Windows and Linux configure INNER IP MTU: the complete inner IPv4/IPv6 packet seen by WBD virtual interfaces, including the inner IP header. It excludes the WBD/Game/FEC envelope, Reality/TLS, FakeTCP, outer IP, and L2/link-layer overhead.
mtu_contract.example_physical_retest: Configure Windows mtu=1300 and Linux WBD_MTU=1300; the internal LINK proposal/policy must be 1340. Never use Windows=1300/Linux=1340 as the final user-facing configuration contract.
mtu_contract.implementation: internal/gamepath/mtu.go is the shared inner->LINK authority; Windows runtime delegates to it and wbd-link-server-mux interprets -mtu as inner MTU then converts internally. scripts/linux_server_manager.sh already validates user WBD_MTU as 576..1460.

fec_contract.wire_geometry: Fixed systematic Reed-Solomon 20:20; header/version and codec geometry are unchanged.
fec_contract.partial_block: FastBlockEncoder now emits N source + N repair after partial flush instead of N source + 20 repair.
fec_contract.why: The old partial N+20 policy caused severe low-rate wire amplification: N=1 produced 21 FEC datagrams and N=3 produced 23. The new live-path behavior restores the intended approximately 100% FEC redundancy target without changing wire format.
fec_contract.expected_measurement: For near-MTU traffic, Game/FEC bytes are roughly about 2.1..2.3x inner bytes before DTLS/FakeTCP/outer-IP/L2 overhead. Aggregate NIC TX+RX, inner fragmentation, and brief make-before-break overlap can raise observed physical ratios. Do not call the previous extra repair 'zero reliability benefit'; it added repeated transmission opportunities but exceeded the fixed redundancy target and did not increase algebraic reconstruction rank after N parity.

implemented_since_last_handoff: Added shared internal/gamepath MTU conversion/bounds and tests: Game private envelope is 40 bytes; 1360 inner -> 1400 LINK; 1460 inner -> 1500 LINK.
Converted server mux MTU policy from user-visible inner MTU to exact LINK plaintext MTU, so both endpoints may use the same user-facing inner value.

Added lost-LEAVE server roll-forward: stale A primary + B overlap + authenticated later C rolls A+B -> B, removes stale A bookkeeping, logs WBD_GAME_LANE_UNBIND reason=lost_leave_rebind_recovery, then admits C as the next overlap.
Changed the live FastBlockEncoder partial flush from N+20 to N+N while keeping full 20+20 and the existing wire/header geometry.
Updated FastBlockEncoder and live internal/linkdata.Path tests to pin bounded partial repair and recovery behavior.
Linux WBD_MTU validation now rejects values above the valid 1460 inner-MTU maximum.

Checkpoint 0703d26125c14345a1b500ce241f86d08f6c9066 adds the product MTU regression contract that explicitly pins default 1360->1400 and max 1460->1500 and ensures the final exact-source candidate triggers the relevant Windows/Linux build paths.
